searchText: Hey <@755590043632140352>, thanks again for your help earlier! I was able to successfully use your tip to roll back my Prysm node to the correct slot using the corresponding block number from the execution payload 🙌 Now I’ve started my beacon node with: ``` --checkpoint-state=/home/data/checkpoint_state.ssz --checkpoint-block=/home/checkpoint_block.ssz ``` But I’m now running into a new issue — the chain is stuck and no new blocks are being proposed. My beacon node is showing this error: ``` ERROR blockchain: Could not compute head from new attestations error=head at slot 25501 with weight 0 is not eligible, finalizedEpoch, justified Epoch 0, 0 != 796, 796 ``` And the validator logs say: ``` ERROR client: Could not request sync message block root to sign error=rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = error=the node is currently optimistic and cannot serve validators ``` The head block root matches between beacon and execution clients, so I believe they're in sync. Is there any way I can force the validator to start proposing blocks despite this optimistic sync state? , or any way to resolve this issue on beacon , By putting --genesis-state instead of this --chckpoint , the error vanishes , but then the head state of beacon moves to 0 , Thanks again for any pointers ! probably should move this outside of ETH R&D and to the Prysm discord, but it seems to me that you are trying reorg a finalized checkpoint and that won't work

excerpts.author: g1.eth
excerpts.content:
Hey <@755590043632140352>, thanks again for your help earlier! I was able to successfully use your tip to roll back my Prysm node to the correct slot using the corresponding block number from the execution payload 🙌

Now I’ve started my beacon node with:

```
--checkpoint-state=/home/data/checkpoint_state.ssz  
--checkpoint-block=/home/checkpoint_block.ssz
```
But I’m now running into a new issue — the chain is stuck and no new blocks are being proposed. My beacon node is showing this error:

```
ERROR blockchain: Could not compute head from new attestations error=head at slot 25501 with weight 0 is not eligible, finalizedEpoch, justified Epoch 0, 0 != 796, 796
```
And the validator logs say:

```
ERROR client: Could not request sync message block root to sign error=rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = error=the node is currently optimistic and cannot serve validators
```

The head block root matches between beacon and execution clients, so I believe they're in sync. Is there any way I can force the validator to start proposing blocks despite this optimistic sync state? , or any way to resolve this issue on beacon , By putting --genesis-state instead of this --chckpoint , the error vanishes , but then the head state of beacon moves to 0 ,

Thanks again for any pointers !
